messages:
maya: Quick sync — long-term roadmap for routing + multi-region tenant isolation. I sketched a proposal with concrete scope slices and launch gates. Want prioritized input + owners. TL;DR: policy primitives (DSL), region pinning & affinity, tenant slices/quota, graceful fallback + fallthrough policies.

sam: Can you call out which customer asks are blocking this vs nice-to-have? e.g., which ones are Q3 MUSTs?

maya: Good Q. From sales/CS: (1) EU data residency + region pinning (enterprise customers), (2) soft-eviction for noisy tenants, (3) per-tenant throughput quotas. Those are blockers for Dedicated/private deals. Others (fine-grained policy DSL) are Q4+.

adele: We should include acceptance metrics up front. Proposal: latency P95 change <= +10ms, cost delta per-tenant <= +8% compared to baseline, canary error increase < 0.5%. Also need telemetry hooks for routing decisions.

chris: A few infra constraints:
- KV-cache locality matters: region pinning can blow cache hit rate if we shard incorrectly.
- Kernel-level batching needs affinity hints; otherwise continuous batching suffers.
- Fallbacks: we need deterministic fallback ordering so we don't oscillate.

sam: Ok — for migration we should plan: canary by tenant band, rollforward/rollback automation, and a mid-rollout smoke test that verifies KV-hit-rate and P95.

maya: Proposed scoped work items (priority order):
1) Region pin + residency hooks (owner: sam)
2) Tenant lanes + quota enforcement (owner: adele)
3) Policy DSL v0 (matchers + simple actions) (owner: maya)
4) Fallback model variants + circuit-breaker policies (owner: chris)
5) Observability: route decision traces + cost attribution (owner: platform-bot)

chris: For the Policy DSL v0, suggest we keep it intentionally small. Example pattern: matching on tenant, region, model, and providing actions (route, fallback, throttle). e.g.:
```
route {
  match: tenant == "acme" && region == "eu"
  action: prefer(region: "eu-west"), quota: 200qps
}
```
No complex expressions in v0.

adele: Launch gates I'd push for:
- Canary coverage: >= 5% of affected traffic across 3 tenants
- Telemetry: route decision traces + per-route cost breakdowns enabled
- SLOs: P95 within agreed delta, error rate unchanged
- Rollback plan documented and automated

sam: FWIW customers pushing region pinning are asking for contractual SLA language. That affects Dedicated/legal timeline. We should flag that for GTM.

platform-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/edge-strata-routing-proposal — includes decision matrix, telemetry checklist, and rollout playbook. (auto-note)

maya: Great. Can we converge on owners + a short RACI by EOD? Sam/adele/chris, please add rough ETA (quarters) to the doc. I'll draft the exec summary for product leadership.

sam: I can take region pinning + residency hooks — target: Q3 beta for Dedicated customers.

adele: I'll own tenant lanes/quota — Q3 for feature flag + Q4 GA.

chris: I'll prototype fallback/circuit logic and test KV cache tradeoffs — prototype lab by end of Q2.

maya: Thanks. Quick ask: add a minimal test plan to the doc with eviction/rollback scenarios. cc @chris for cache tests. :thumbsup:

sam: Added a one-pager in the doc with migration strategy. linking it now.

chris: I'll add automation and smoke tests. also want a small perf benchmark harness so we can measure P95 impact before canary.

maya: Perfect. We'll review progress in next architecture sync. If anyone has urgent objections to the scope order, speak now — otherwise I'll publish this as the working roadmap. :rocket:
